# Addiction Breaker 1.0.0 beta

Addiction Breaker 1.0.0 public Android beta.

A private journal and recovery support toolkit. Google account sign-in/out and account sync between Android and web have been confirmed on the developer's Android phone. Individual-account isolation, data export/deletion, and additional privacy checks require wider testing. This is not emergency, medical or addiction-treatment advice.

This Android beta uses a WebView of the hosted app. Google OAuth works in the developer's device test, but a compliant external-browser sign-in flow may be needed before distribution through Google Play. Download and use the APK only if comfortable testing beta software with sensitive personal records. Requires internet access for hosted service and account sync. No Play Store submission.

### Installation

Download the attached `.apk` release asset. On Android, approve installation from the browser or file manager if prompted. Download only from this official GitHub repository. The file is signed by the existing Expo EAS build credentials.
